$description: Generated from DESIGN.md by `cargo xtask design`. Do not edit. Colors are the default appearance.

text.$description: Body text; step 12 is Radix's high-contrast text.

text-secondary.$description: Labels, captions and the field note; step 11 is Radix's low-contrast text, still AA on steps 1-3.

accent-text.$description: Accented text on a plain surface, such as a link in widget content.

accent-strong.$description: Text on a soft accent; step 11 on step 3 of the same scale is 4.25:1 for blue, under 4.5:1.

border-control.$description: A control's boundary identifies it and needs 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11); Radix's border steps 6-8 fall short.

divider.$description: Radix's border step for UI elements: it outlines every frame, panel and dialog, divides rows and closes the chrome. A firm line instead of a shadow keeps the edges sharp.

ok-icon.$description: The status icon carries the status beside gray text, so it needs 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11).

warning-icon.$description: As ok-icon; amber 9 is too light to carry meaning on a light surface.

focus.$description: The host's own focus ring, in the host's ink: Radix's focus-ring steps 7-8 fail 3:1, and a widget-colored ring would vanish on lime or sky.

host-strong.$description: The host's ink: the fill of the monogram and of the actions the host draws in a frame's header. Step 12 of the host color, so it stays quiet when many widgets sit together.

on-host-strong.$description: Text on the host's ink: the monogram's letter and a header action's name.

canvas.$description: The window behind the frames: a step darker than a frame in the light theme, so a frame reads as one sheet by its tone and its line, with no shadow.

surface.$description: A widget's frame and the fields drawn in it. Its tone alone is close to the canvas, so the frame is outlined by the divider too.

neutral-soft.$description: Buttons, the monogram and badges: Radix's component background step.

accent-soft.$description: An accented button or badge: the widget color's component background step.

ok-soft.$description: The background of an ok badge.

warning-soft.$description: The background of a warning badge.

error-soft.$description: The background of an error badge.

chrome-surface.$description: The host's own bar, in the host color when there is one; no frame or panel covers it.

dialog-surface.$description: A host dialog's surface; what tells a dialog apart is its form, not this color.

panel-surface.$description: The panel a frame opens for a plugin's controls, attached to that frame.

scrim.$description: Dims the window behind a host dialog; blackA because gray 12 is near white in the dark theme.

full.$description: The monogram, always a circle, and every corner when the person picks full.
